parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by an ideal gas.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem: An ideal gas at a pressure of $1.6 \times 10^5 \text{Pa}$ has a density of $1.9 \text{kg m}^{-3}$.
parts.text: Show that the root-mean-square (r.m.s.) speed of molecules of this gas is approximately $500 \text{m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
One molecule of the gas has a mass of $4.7 \times 10^{-26} \text{kg}$.

Determine the thermodynamic temperature of the gas.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Calculate the internal energy $U$ of $6.0 \text{mol}$ of the gas in (b). Explain your reasoning.
